verdict.rationale: Portkey's load balancing spreads traffic across multiple provider targets so no single provider becomes a bottleneck. Retries use exponential backoff or honor the provider's retry-after headers, fallbacks can trigger on specific status codes such as 429, and admins can set per-minute, hourly, or daily request and token rate limits. Missing for 10: explicit request queuing, evidence that load balancing spreads load across multiple keys of the same provider specifically to avoid provider limits (the rate limits shown are Portkey-key governance controls), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
